ma_vardir.description: Directory for cached data used by helper scripts. Corresponds to MA_VARDIR environment variable.

module_loc.description: Base directory for extracted module source directories. Corresponds to MODULE_LOC environment variable.

kernel_dirs.description: List of kernel source/header directories. Corresponds to KERNELDIRS environment variable and -k option.

mod_srcdir.description: Location for module source tarballs. Corresponds to MOD_SRCDIR environment variable.

root_cmd.description: Wrapper command to execute privileged operations. Corresponds to ROOT_CMD environment variable.

kmaint.description: Real name of the package builder. Corresponds to KMAINT/DEBFULLNAME environment variable.

kemail.description: Email address of the package builder. Corresponds to KEMAIL/DEBEMAIL environment variable.

auto_build_commands.description: Preferred sequence of m-a commands for automated module building workflows.
